events.speaker: caller
events.text: Hi, this is Daniel from the Lone Star Bank fraud department. Am I speaking with the account holder?

events.speaker: caller
events.text: We've flagged a 1,240 dollar transfer to an account in Ohio. Did you authorize that?

events.speaker: caller
events.text: Okay, I'm going to secure your account right now. Please don't hang up and don't call the branch, it will reset the case.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: You just got a six digit code. Read it back to me so I can verify it's you and cancel the transfer.

events.speaker: caller
events.text: After that we'll move your balance to a protected safe account until this is resolved.
